patterns: PYQs are direct: 'not an attribute of local government' (central control) and the Article directing organisation of panchayats (Art. 40).
Odd-one-out feature traps (non-confidence, public order, judicial review) are the common shape.
No APPSC PYQ on concepts like deconcentration/delegation/devolution; these come via Panchayati Raj questions.
App adds conceptual and debate items (subsidiarity, 3Fs, Ambedkar's 1948 view, 64th Bill) at a depth beyond the PYQs, but they are sound.
